notes.title: Experience our teaser demo at PAX West 2024. See you soon, Seattle!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147896/6132864efa977619b9066335c1c757af1e0570fb.png[/img]

After a successful weekend reaching out to gamers in New York City, Whiskers will be on the road again this coming weekend at PAX West 2024. Find us roaming the grounds of the Washington Convention Center by listening for frustrated, angry, enraged screaming! We’ll be on delivering catharsis without consequences with our mobile demo station. We hope to see you there! 

First Person Shouter will be roaming the Seattle Convention Center between 10am and 6pm on Friday, August 30th and Sunday, September 1st
